title: The Beginning
body: Iron Man launched the Marvel Cinematic Universe in 2008, with Robert Downey Jr.'s iconic performance as Tony Stark setting the tone for everything that followed.

title: Post-Credit Pioneer
body: Iron Man's post-credits scene featuring Nick Fury established the template for MCU's interconnected storytelling, teasing the Avengers Initiative.

title: Infinity Stones
body: The Infinity Saga spans 23 films across Phases 1-3, culminating in Avengers: Endgame. The six Infinity Stones were introduced gradually throughout the saga.

title: The Snap
body: Avengers: Infinity War shocked audiences worldwide with its ending. Half of all life in the universe disappeared, including many beloved heroes.

title: Multiverse Opens
body: Spider-Man: No Way Home and Doctor Strange in the Multiverse of Madness opened the door to the multiverse, bringing back characters from previous Marvel film franchises.

title: Practical Effects
body: Despite heavy CGI use, the MCU often employs practical effects. Captain America's shield was often a real prop, and many stunts were performed by actors and stunt teams.

title: Stan Lee Cameos
body: Stan Lee appeared in nearly every MCU film until his passing in 2018. His cameos became a beloved tradition, celebrating the creator of many Marvel characters.

title: Comic Origins
body: The Infinity Gauntlet storyline from the comics inspired the Infinity Saga, though the MCU took creative liberties with character roles and outcomes.
